name: south-africa-population-2002-2026
title: South Africa's mid-year population by province, 2002 to 2026 (Stats SA, 2026 series)
description: Mid-year population of South Africa and its nine provinces for every year from 2002 to 2026, all from Stats SA's 2026 mid-year population estimates (P0302), summed from Stats SA's district council projection by sex and age.

These tables are MzansiData's processing of Stats SA's data. If you use them, name Stats SA as the source of the basic data and say that any analysis is your own.
